# Ashley Hinson Watchdog File

**Subject:** Ashley Hinson, Republican nominee for U.S. Senate in Iowa, 2026, U.S. Representative for IA-2
**Compiled:** October 25, 2026 for the On Point Politics watchdog database, onpointpolitics.us
**Data cutoff:** October 24, 2026. The latest candidate figures found are second quarter 2026 FEC reports through June 30, 2026.
**Next scheduled data drop:** FEC pre-general report covering through October 14, 2026, not found in this pass, then the post-general report due December 3, 2026.

## Bottom line up front

Hinson is the party's candidate with the cash. She raised $10,262,866 through June 30, 2026 and held $6,749,491, nearly three times Josh Turek's cash, per Little Village on July 17, 2026, https://littlevillagemag.com/turek-democrats-outraise-republicans/. The NRSC committed $29 million to help her and One Nation planned $11 million.

Four interests combine money with a decision she would touch:

1. **Senate Republican leadership.** The NRSC, the Senate Leadership Fund and One Nation carry her air war. The decision is the Senate majority in January 2027.
2. **Agribusiness and the carbon pipeline.** Bruce Rastetter, founder of Summit Agricultural Group, gives and raises for her. Summit's pipeline is the most unpopular project in Iowa farm politics, and she has no public position on it in sources read.
3. **Her own holdings.** Democrats say her household kept $1 million to $5 million of private insurance agency stock while she backs a narrower stock bill. Her campaign calls the attack a lie. The decision is a congressional ownership ban.
4. **Health care.** She voted for the 2025 law that Democrats say cut Medicaid, which is the center of more than $30 million in Senate Majority PAC reservations against her.

## Committee structure and treasurer

The roster lists her House FEC candidate ID, H0IA01174. The Senate committee name, ID and treasurer were not verified. Legis1 reported on June 2, 2026 that a joint fundraising committee funded by GOP leadership PACs supports her, without names, https://legis1.com/news/iowa-senate-2026-election-whos-paying-for-the. She raised nearly $1.7 million in the fourth quarter of 2025 and had nearly $5.2 million at year end, per the Cedar Rapids Gazette, https://www.thegazette.com/campaigns-elections/ashley-hinson-takes-massive-fundraising-edge-in-iowas-open-seat-u-s-senate-campaign/. She raised $2,375,039 in the first quarter and $2,059,828 in the second.

## Senate Republican leadership

Documented. The NRSC committed $29 million, per Scripps on June 2, 2026, https://www.abc15.com/politics/paralympic-athlete-wins-key-iowa-democratic-senate-primary. One Nation, a sister group of the Senate Leadership Fund, planned $11 million in ads on the estate tax, veterans and costs. The Senate Leadership Fund flew an anti-Turek banner at the State Fair, per Bleeding Heartland on August 24, 2026, https://www.bleedingheartland.com/?p=458547. Trump and Joni Ernst endorsed her, Ernst on January 10, 2026, per Ballotpedia News, https://news.ballotpedia.org/2026/08/06/turek-hinson-running-for-open-u-s-senate-seat-in-iowa-as-ernst-retires/.

Inference: Leadership groups, not individual donors, are her largest source of support. Their ask is a reliable Senate vote.

## Agribusiness and the carbon pipeline

Documented. Bleeding Heartland reports that Rastetter, a figure behind the Summit Carbon Solutions pipeline, has donated to Hinson and is helping her raise from other large donors. An Iowa Democratic Party release of August 11, 2026 relays Iowa Starting Line: Rastetter and Summit CEO Justin Kirchhoff hosted an August 5 fundraiser for her and together have given nearly $60,000 to her committees since 2019, https://iowademocrats.org/?p=38664. That figure is Secondary because the underlying report was not read. The same release cites a March 2023 Iowa Poll finding 78 percent of Iowans opposed eminent domain for pipelines.

What they want. A path for the pipeline and federal carbon capture support.

Inference: This is the clearest case in the file of a bloc with money and no stated position. Her primary rival Jim Carlin used it against her and still took just under 26 percent.

## Own finances and disclosure history

A Heartland Signal report relayed by the Iowa Democratic Party on June 12, 2026 says her household net worth rose from at most $1.6 million before office to as much as $8 million by 2024. It says her husband sold his stake in the Elliott Hartman Agency to a private equity platform for more than $1 million within months of her taking office, and the household kept $1 million to $5 million in private stock, https://insurancenewsnet.com/oarticle/breaking-iowa-senate-candidate-ashley-hinson-touts-congressional-stock-ban-while-a-loophole-fueled-her-own-wealth. A second release on July 6, 2026 relays MeidasTouch, https://iowademocrats.org/2026/07/06/breaking-ashley-hinson-lied-about-owning-stock-while-campaigning-against-insider-trading-in-congress/. Her campaign told KCAU on June 16 that this was a shameless lie from partisan hacks. It said the couple sold individual stocks and hold ETFs and mutual funds, while her husband retains private stock in the business. Status Contested. Her own disclosure was not read.

## Enforcement and controversies

- No FEC or House Ethics matter against Hinson was found in sources read. She sits on the House Ethics Committee per the roster.
- Senate Majority PAC ads on August 24 say she missed nearly 200 votes and backed a tax break for her family business. Her response to those specific claims was not found.
- Turek's campaign says she skipped part of a June 24 defense markup for a fundraiser, per Fox News, https://www.foxnews.com/politics/dem-senate-hopeful-pocketed-massive-taxpayer-funded-cash-while-skipping-hundreds-votes.

## Deal table

| Interest | Money in | Ask | Lever | Stake | Decision date |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Senate GOP leadership | NRSC $29M committed; One Nation $11M | Senate majority | Organizing vote | Senate control | January 2027 |
| Agribusiness and pipeline | Rastetter and Kirchhoff nearly $60K since 2019, secondary | Pipeline and carbon credits | Federal carbon policy | Not quantified | 2027 to 2028 |
| Her household holdings | Not a donor | Narrow stock rules | Ownership ban vote | $1M to $5M private stock, contested | 2027 to 2028 |
| Health care | Not measured | Medicaid policy | Reconciliation votes | Not quantified | 2027 to 2028 |

## Levers and calendar

| Decision | Who holds it now | When | Which donors care |
|---|---|---|---|
| Stock trading and ownership ban | Congress | 2027 to 2028 | Ethics groups |
| Carbon capture and pipelines | Congress, regulators | 2027 to 2028 | Rastetter, Summit |
| Medicaid | Congress | 2027 to 2028 | Health care interests |
| Tariffs | President, Congress | Ongoing | Agribusiness |
| FY2027 spending bills | House Appropriations, her current seat | Through December 2026 | Defense, agriculture |

Calendar. November 3, 2026 election. She keeps her House Appropriations seat until January 3, 2027. FEC post-general report December 3, 2026. Senate organizing vote January 2027.

## What we could not verify

- Senate committee ID, treasurer, and the joint fundraising committee's name.
- Third quarter and pre-general totals.
- Top PACs and individual donors with amounts; Legis1 relays OpenSecrets industries, finance, insurance and real estate, health care, lawyers and lobbyists, without amounts.
- The Iowa Starting Line report on Rastetter; the Heartland Signal and MeidasTouch reports; her House disclosures.
- Bodies not read: https://iowademocrats.org/?p=38443 and https://www.telegraphherald.com/news/tri-state/article_da73262e-23cd-43de-a056-daf8a30a1414.amp.html and https://bluewaterhealthyliving.com/news/national-news/iowa/turek-leads-in-quarterly-senate-fundraising-hinson-holds-3x-more-cash/ and https://punchbowl.news/?p=155676

# Ashley Hinson research notes

Audit trail for IA-ashley-hinson, compiled October 25, 2026, sharing searches with the Turek file.

## Thread 1: Committees and totals

### Takeaway
Totals are clear through June 30, 2026. Committee IDs are not.

### Cited findings
- Q4 2025 nearly $1.7M raised, about $563,000 spent, nearly $5.2M cash. https://www.thegazette.com/campaigns-elections/ashley-hinson-takes-massive-fundraising-edge-in-iowas-open-seat-u-s-senate-campaign/
- Q1 $2,375,039; Q2 $2,059,828; cycle $10,262,866; cash $6,749,491 June 30. https://littlevillagemag.com/turek-democrats-outraise-republicans/
- $6.5M campaign cash and $6.9M across authorized committees entering June; GOP leadership PAC funded JFC. https://legis1.com/news/iowa-senate-2026-election-whos-paying-for-the

### Gaps
- Q3 and pre-general figures.

## Thread 2: Outside money

### Cited findings
- NRSC $29M commitment; Trump endorsement. https://www.abc15.com/politics/paralympic-athlete-wins-key-iowa-democratic-senate-primary
- One Nation $11M; SLF banner; SMP $1.45M ad with net worth and missed vote claims. https://www.bleedingheartland.com/?p=458547
- SMP $13.4M and $17M; Majority Forward; her OBBBA vote, tariff support and Iran war stance. https://carrollspaper.com/news/state/national-democratic-pac-announces-17m-fall-ad-buy-targeting-ashley-hinson/article_e0ddbe2b-627a-5a45-87c1-1e78edda100a.html

## Thread 3: Agribusiness

### Cited findings
- Rastetter donates and raises for her. https://www.bleedingheartland.com/?p=458547
- Aug 5 fundraiser hosts; nearly $60K since 2019; 78 percent oppose eminent domain for pipelines. https://iowademocrats.org/?p=38664

### Inferences
- Silence on the pipeline while taking Rastetter's help is a flag under the protocol.

### Gaps
- Starting Line report; FEC itemized records.

## Thread 4: Own finances

### Cited findings
- Net worth claims, agency stake sale, discharge petition, no comment. https://insurancenewsnet.com/oarticle/breaking-iowa-senate-candidate-ashley-hinson-touts-congressional-stock-ban-while-a-loophole-fueled-her-own-wealth
- Campaign response on June 16 to KCAU. https://iowademocrats.org/2026/07/06/breaking-ashley-hinson-lied-about-owning-stock-while-campaigning-against-insider-trading-in-congress/

### Gaps
- Her disclosures themselves.

## Campaign intel

- Main message: Trump endorsed Republican running on taxes, veterans and costs, with One Nation ads on ending the estate tax and her own ads attacking Turek since June. https://www.bleedingheartland.com/?p=458547 and https://www.abc15.com/politics/paralympic-athlete-wins-key-iowa-democratic-senate-primary
- Biggest vulnerability as opponents frame it: personal enrichment. Senate Majority PAC says her net worth grew by $8M in Washington and that she backed a tax break for her family business; Democrats say she kept private insurance agency stock. Her campaign calls it a shameless lie. https://www.bleedingheartland.com/?p=458547 and https://iowademocrats.org/2026/07/06/breaking-ashley-hinson-lied-about-owning-stock-while-campaigning-against-insider-trading-in-congress/
- Second vulnerability: health costs and Medicaid after her vote for the 2025 law, the core of more than $30M in Democratic reservations. https://carrollspaper.com/news/state/national-democratic-pac-announces-17m-fall-ad-buy-targeting-ashley-hinson/article_e0ddbe2b-627a-5a45-87c1-1e78edda100a.html
- Strongest coalition: party infrastructure and cash. She had $6,749,491 on June 30 and the NRSC committed $29M. Iowa has about an 8 point Republican registration edge and Trump won it by 13 in 2024. https://littlevillagemag.com/turek-democrats-outraise-republicans/ and https://legis1.com/news/iowa-senate-2026-election-whos-paying-for-the
- Notable recent event: Bleeding Heartland reported on August 24 that Republicans seem increasingly worried, with Cook calling the race a toss up; she has since called the Iran war a political liability. https://www.bleedingheartland.com/?p=458547 and https://carrollspaper.com/news/state/national-democratic-pac-announces-17m-fall-ad-buy-targeting-ashley-hinson/article_e0ddbe2b-627a-5a45-87c1-1e78edda100a.html
- Pipeline exposure: Rastetter and Summit's CEO hosted an August 5 fundraiser for her while 78 percent of Iowans opposed eminent domain for pipelines in a 2023 poll. https://iowademocrats.org/?p=38664
